findings.title: Industry Takedown of Botnet Hidden in More Than 1.3 Million TV Set-Top Boxes across 200 Countries
findings.summary_md: A coalition of Google, Plume, TrendAI, Lumen, HUMAN Security, Synthient, and Japan's National Police Agency announced a coordinated takedown of the X.CPE botnet hidden in more than 1.3 million set-top boxes across more than 200 countries. The backdoor was embedded in device firmware before sale, and the takedown of affiliate command-and-control domains was expected to cut access to at least 10 million additional compromised devices.

findings.title: Google Leads Industry Takedown of Botnet Hidden in More Than 1.3 Million Set-Top Boxes across 200 Countries - Plume
findings.summary_md: Plume announced the same coordinated X.CPE takedown, noting the botnet used subscribers' devices and home internet connections without consent and that Google banned Videostrong from certified Android manufacturing. Plume contributed broadband intelligence and linked to its whitepaper on the botnet's device-management-to-monetization framework.
